title: Member Appeals Program Overturn Service Levels
content:
When a denial is overturned under the Member Appeals Program, Northbridge must act within the service levels below. The service levels depend on the member's Northbridge Appeals package.

| Package | Coverage in effect after an internal overturn of a pre-service appeal (hours) | Post-service reimbursement paid after an overturn (calendar days) | Coverage in effect after an external overturn (hours) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Appeals Level One Delegated | 72 | 30 | 0 (no external review) |
| Northbridge Appeals Two-Level Delegated | 72 | 30 | 0 (no external review) |
| Northbridge Appeals Single-Level with External Review | 72 | 30 | 24 |
| Northbridge Appeals Two-Level with External Review | 24 | 15 | 24 |
| Northbridge Appeals State-Regulated Insured | 24 | 15 | 24 |
| Northbridge Appeals Full Fiduciary Delegation | 24 | 15 | 24 |

**Reimbursement after an overturn (all six packages).** A member may have paid for the drug while the appeal was pending. If the denial is then overturned, the member is reimbursed at the network rate less the member's normal cost share.

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- *Internal overturn under Northbridge Appeals Single-Level with External Review.* A pre-service appeal is overturned at the internal level. Coverage is put in effect within 72 hours of the overturn.
- *Internal overturn under Northbridge Appeals Full Fiduciary Delegation.* The same internal overturn would require coverage to be in effect within 24 hours.
- *Reimbursement under Northbridge Appeals Two-Level Delegated.* The member paid $40.00 for a fill while the appeal was pending, and the network rate less normal cost share for that fill comes to $28.00. After the overturn, the reimbursement is $28.00, paid within 30 calendar days. Under Northbridge Appeals State-Regulated Insured the same reimbursement is paid within 15 calendar days.
